interface.name: tinexus_global_shortcut_manager_v1
interface.description: This interface allows a client to register global keyboard shortcuts with the compositor. It supports priority levels and conflict detection to ensure critical system actions (like launcher) are not overridden by lower-priority plugins.

entry.name: conflict
entry.summary: Shortcut is already registered by a higher or equal priority client

request.name: register_shortcut
request.description: Requests to register a shortcut string (e.g. "ctrl+shift+space", "super+p"). If the shortcut is already bound with a higher or equal priority, a conflict error is raised via the shortcut object.

arg.name: key_combo
arg.summary: String representation of the key combination

arg.name: description
arg.summary: Human readable description of the action

interface.name: tinexus_global_shortcut_v1
interface.description: Represents a single registered global shortcut. Allows enabling, disabling, and receiving activation events.

event.name: registered
event.description: Sent when the compositor confirms the shortcut has been registered without conflicts.

event.name: registration_failed
event.description: Sent if the registration fails due to conflict or reserved keys. The object becomes inert.

event.name: activated
event.description: Sent when the user presses the shortcut combination.

request.name: enable
request.description: Enables the shortcut if it was previously disabled.

request.name: disable
request.description: Temporarily disables the shortcut without unregistering it.

request.name: rebind

description.summary: rebind to a new key combination

request.description: Requests changing the key combination for this existing shortcut object. May trigger a registration_failed event if the new combo conflicts.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Unregisters the shortcut and destroys the object.
